Title: Generally Available: Azure Backup standard policies support for Trusted Launch virtual Machines

Body.Content: Trusted Launch support with standard backup policies enables seamless backup configuration for secure VMs, aligning with Trusted Launch becoming the default across VM creation interfaces. This enhancement ensures continuity for automation workflows using PowerShell, CLI, or REST APIs, eliminating the need for policy change in scripts and preventing failures.
